last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now applies the anti-lag soft spark-skip ratio only while anti-lag is both enabled and actively engaged. Previously the configured skip ratio could suppress sparks whenever the limiter was evaluated, even with anti-lag disabled or not armed. The change is a firmware behavior fix with unit-test coverage; no tune migration is required, but anti-lag spark skipping should be re-verified on the bench.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU changed anti-lag soft spark skipping so the configured ALSSkipRatio is applied only when anti-lag is enabled and the anti-lag controller reports an active condition; otherwise the target skip ratio is zero. Drivers and tuners no longer lose sparks to a stale skip ratio when anti-lag is off or not armed, and skipping resumes when anti-lag re-arms. No tune migration is needed, but re-check anti-lag spark behavior on the bench because the change is validated only by unit tests, not on an engine.
evidence: firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp: ALSSkipRatio now computed as antiLagEnabled && antilagController.isAntilagCondition ? ALSSkipRatio : 0.0f and applied via ALSsoftSparkLimiter.setTargetSkipRatio() at the top of onTriggerEventSparkLogic
firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp: removed the unconditional setTargetSkipRatio(engineConfiguration->ALSSkipRatio) call from the per-event scheduling loop
